g.text: PR #2443 - Claude ListAgents scope reminder
Native ListAgents is not a complete Portal inventory.
A post-tool reminder points Claude to peers across computers and providers.
BEFORE
AFTER
Claude calls ListAgents
Native tool returns its own inventory.
No contextual scope reminder
Other computers and providers can be absent.
The result can look like a complete peer list.
Claude calls ListAgents
Native result remains unchanged.
PostToolUse: ^ListAgents$
additionalContext becomes a system reminder
beside the tool result, before the next model call.
Existing settings and hooks are preserved.
agent-portal message list
Discover accessible Portal sessions across hosts
and providers. Normal permissions still apply.
Applied at launch in both native and shim paths.
No user settings files are modified.
Scope: newly started Claude processes; explicit hook-disabling policy still applies. No expansion of session access.
